Learn More Achieve Results Through Personalized Aesthetic Care Treatments built around your goals with direct provider attention Glow Med Spa Maine offers advanced aesthetic and wellness treatments across Augusta and Waterville, combining medical expertise with a personalized approach. Maine's seasonal shifts and lifestyle demands make year-round skin care, hormone balance, and preventative wellness especially relevant for residents managing both indoor and outdoor exposure. Founded by AANP-certified FNP-C Nikki Lyford, the practice delivers results-driven care tailored to each person's unique needs. When you arrive, you'll meet one-on-one with licensed estheticians, certified nurses, or experienced medical providers who take time to understand your concerns and outline a clear path forward. Every treatment is customized based on your skin type, wellness goals, and lifestyle, so you know what to expect from the start. There's no guesswork—just focused attention and a plan built specifically for you. Glow Med Spa Maine serves clients throughout Augusta, Waterville, and surrounding communities with convenient access to services including Laser Treatments , Botox, PRP Injections, Peptide Therapy, and Glo2Facial. Whether you're addressing fine lines, seeking hormonal support, or managing weight loss goals, you'll work directly with professionals who prioritize your outcomes and well-being. Reach out to Glow Med Spa Maine in Augusta or Waterville to discuss your aesthetic and wellness goals with a certified provider.
